reviews.text: I've tried UNOVE's damage repair mask for a while now and decided to try the shampoo and it's honestly really nice. The scent is really nice and classy and I feel like the shampoo really cleans my scalp nicely. It foams up pretty easy and the pump packaging makes it really convenient.
reviews.zh: 我用咗 UNOVE 嘅損傷修復髮膜一段時間，之後決定試吓呢款洗頭水，老實講都好好用。味道好好聞，又有格調，我覺得呢款洗頭水真係可以將頭皮洗得好乾淨。佢好容易起泡，而且泵頭包裝用起嚟好方便。

reviews.text: Unfortunately, this shampoo didn’t work for my hair. It left my hair feeling very dry, stiff and almost matted, similar to the feeling I get after using a strong clarifying shampoo. My hair was difficult to detangle afterwards and didn’t feel soft or nourished. The scent is nice, but I wouldn’t repurchase it.
reviews.zh: 可惜呢款洗頭水唔啱我嘅頭髮。洗完之後頭髮好乾、好硬，而且差不多會打結成一團，好似用咗強效清潔洗髮水之後嘅感覺咁。之後梳頭都好難解開，感覺唔柔軟，亦冇被滋養到。味道幾好聞，但係我唔會再買。

reviews.text: Despite all the great reviews, this shampoo unfortunately didn’t work for me. The scent is a bit too strong for my taste, and I noticed that it gives me a lot of dandruff. On the other hand, my friend absolutely loves it and said she would definitely buy it again. I guess it really depends on your hair and scalp type!
reviews.zh: 雖然好多評論都好好，但係呢款洗頭水對我冇用。味道對我嚟講有啲太濃，而且我發現佢令我多咗好多頭皮屑。另一方面，我朋友非常鍾意，仲話佢一定會再買。我諗呢個真係要睇你嘅髮質同頭皮類型！

reviews.text: HOLY GRAIL SHAMPOO! This is my hair after the FIRST wash! Do you see how ✨SHINY✨ she is?!! My bestie even complimented me saying how healthy my hair looks now! I wish I would have remembered to take a before photo because my hair was SO. DULL. and lifeless. I also had terrible split ends and a lot of damage from when I used to bleach my hair and brush it while it was still wet. This shampoo makes my hair so shiny, soft and healthy that I even have the confidence to wear it down in public! I will be honest, I was worried that I wouldn’t like the scent, but it actually smells good and it is so subtle that you can barely smell it when your hair is dry. Thank you UNOVE for giving that confidence back to me, you have a forever loyal fan in me!
reviews.zh: 神級洗頭水！呢個係我第一次洗完頭之後嘅樣！你見唔見到佢幾✨閃亮✨呀？！！我最好嘅朋友仲讚我，話我頭髮而家睇落好健康！我真係好後悔冇記得影返個「之前」嘅相，因為我嘅頭髮真係好～暗淡冇生氣。我仲有好嚴重嘅分叉，都係因為以前我經常漂髮，又喺頭髮仲濕嗰陣就梳，搞到損傷好多。呢款洗頭水令我頭髮閃亮、柔軟又健康，令我有信心喺公眾場合放落頭髮出街！我老實講，我之前擔心唔鍾意佢嘅味道，但係佢其實好好聞，而且味道好淡，頭髮乾咗之後幾乎聞唔到。多謝 UNOVE 令我重拾呢份信心，你哋令我成為永遠嘅忠實粉絲！

reviews.text: If you have curly hair like me and are wondering if this might work on your hair. Girl, this is your sing because this clears your scalp and also softens your hair so it is easy to detangle so it feels like butter on your fingers. I also feel like my curls are stronger and softer since I started using it!
reviews.zh: 如果你同我一樣係卷髮，又想知道呢款會唔會啱你嘅頭髮。姊妹，呢款就係你嘅信號！因為佢可以清潔頭皮，又令頭髮變柔軟，所以好易梳開，摸落好似牛油咁滑。我仲覺得，自從我開始用咗之後，我嘅卷曲感好似更加有力、更加柔軟。

reviews.text: I have recently changed all my hair care products to only Korean hair products. I love this line and I will not be going back to anything else. I will be using this line forever. My hair has seen positive changes after only the first wash. I will be repurchasing this.
reviews.zh: 我最近將所有護髮產品都換成韓國品牌。我好鍾意呢個系列，唔會再返去用其他嘢。我會永遠用呢個系列。我嘅頭髮第一次洗完之後已經有正面嘅改變。我會再買。

reviews.text: i bought this and the same conditioner and they both make my hair so soft. i tried it once and after 4 days, my hair is not as oily as it should be. i can really feel a difference after a single wash. i wash my hair twice a week and after 3 days it already gets oily. but with the shampoo and conditioner it’s not as oily, or even oily at all! i do not visibly see a difference because my hair is not damaged but i can feel how soft it is even after a few days after washing.
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢款同埋同一款護髮素，兩樣都令我頭髮好軟。我試過一次，用咗之後四日，頭髮冇我預期咁油。一次洗頭之後，我已經真係感覺到分別。我每個星期洗兩次頭，三日之後頭髮就已經開始油。但係用咗洗頭水同護髮素之後，就冇咁油，甚至完全唔油！我冇見到明顯嘅分別，因為我嘅頭髮冇受損，不過即使洗完之後過咗幾日，我都感覺到頭髮好軟。
